concepts.def: Square frame used to sample organisms in a known area
Line along which samples are taken to study change
Mean per quadrat × total area in quadrats
Energy transferred ÷ energy supplied, as a %
Dry mass of living material in g or kg

walkthroughs.body_html:
Drop quadrats at random in a field.

Count species per quadrat. Mean × total quadrats in the field = estimated population.

Example: 4 dandelions per 0.25 m² in a 100 m² field → 4 × (100 ÷ 0.25) = 1600.

Capture, mark (M), release. Later capture C and count marked R.

N = (M × C) ÷ R. M=20, C=25, R=5 → N = (20 × 25) ÷ 5 = 100.

Efficiency = (energy in next level ÷ energy in previous) × 100.

50 000 kJ → 4 000 kJ: 4000 ÷ 50000 × 100 = 8%.
